question.text: If 2 and 6 are the roots of the equation $a x^2+b x+1=0$, then the quadratic equation, whose roots are $\frac{1}{2 a+b}$ and $\frac{1}{6 a+b}$, is :

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & \text { Sum }=8=-\frac{b}{a} \\ & \text { Product }=12=\frac{1}{a} \quad \Rightarrow a=\frac{1}{12} \\ & b=-\frac{2}{3} \\ & 2 a+b=\frac{2}{12}-\frac{2}{3}=-\frac{1}{2} \\ & 6 a+b=\frac{6}{12}-\frac{2}{3}=-\frac{1}{6} \\ & \text { sum }=-8 \\ & P=12 \\ & x^2+8 x+12=0\end{aligned}$
